items.prompt: Why serialize a Fraction as"11/8"rather than an unqualified float?

options.text: JSON numbers always preserve every rational exactly
options.why: Finite binary floats cannot represent every rational.

options.text: It hides the result from reviewers
options.why: The documented exact text is inspectable and parseable.

options.text: It authorizes eval on any received string
options.why: Never use eval on untrusted values.

options.text: It preserves the exact rational estimate
options.why: A decimal display conversion needs its own rounding policy.

items.explanation: Wire-format conversion is part of the numerical contract; do not silently change the estimate while keeping an unadjusted bound.
